During the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] launched an '''attack''' on the [[Mephout system/Legends|Mephout system]]. The Nagai raiders targeted the government of the [[Mephout Dominion/Legends|Mephout Dominion]], an isolated [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], which at that point had not yet officially aligned itself with the [[Alliance of Free Planets]].
